trigger: Programming preferences route CLI work to the programming playbook.
Use ARTIFACTS.md before deciding the output format for a substantial report, brief, plan, review, explainer, or design artifact.

Use GITHUB_WORKFLOW.md for GitHub issue drafting, PR drafting/creation, PR descriptions, branch handoffs, merge expectations, workflow labels, and issue closure, including follow-ups from another skill's report.
Use IMPLEMENT_FEATURES.md before starting feature-sized implementation work or treating a feature issue as ready for coding.
Use PROPAGATION_REVIEW_QUEUE.md when agent outputs propose durable AgentOS state changes.
Use WEEKLY_REVIEW.md as the Core template when asked for a weekly review or general AgentOS health check; private reports belong in personal/os/memory/weekly-review/.
Use PORTABILITY.md before adapting AgentOS to another tool.
Use programming/MARKDOWN.md for Markdown source style.
Before changing skill behavior, read the skills manifest and skill contract.
